answer: A reputation escrow with slashing stops sybils: each identity locks 500 POA for 30 days, as three peers audit 40 hours of verified work. Each identity answers a challenge in 60 seconds, so one operator cannot echo one keystroke across 1,000 shells; a karst trace follows deposits to 90-day-seasoned wallets. A 7-day window lets peers flag fakes; a proven fake loses its 500 POA and its reputation score. Forging 1,000 fakes burns 500,000 POA and 40,000 hours: $10,000 at $0.02 per POA, 4.5 years of nonstop work. A sybil farm here is like a saffron harvester with no flowers: all cost, no crop.
